punchline: Lawler matched Yasmin over lunch, then sprang a recruitment pitch on her over dinner.
thirty_sec: CIA case officer Jim Lawler befriended Yasmin, a young Middle Eastern foreign ministry employee, posing as an oil speculator. When he finally told her he was CIA and offered her a job, she was horrified and wanted only to get away from him.
question: Think of a recent time you asked for something right after someone told you how they felt; what would you say first next time?
key_contrast: Rapport at lunch did not carry over to a very different kind of conversation at dinner.
